pairs.situation: The user asks to delete a merged branch; R156 permits deleting it, while R24 forbids deleting any git branch.
During pre-test setup, deleting all map and player data includes world save files while the user has not given explicit permission to delete them.

Adding a new object as part of a complete new level: R28 requires flat game/objects/XX-name.c and .h files, while R81 requires a game/objects/XX-name/ directory with a JSON descriptor and C or ASM source.
When resetting a fork's main branch to fix version state, R118 forbids force-pushing fork main while R131 requires force-pushing the reset main branch to origin.
